Counterpoint's Wei Sun discusses China's AI outlook under US chip curbs

Counterpoint Research

Updated US chip controls further restrict access to the advanced semiconductors needed to train frontier AI models. Wei Sun, Principal Analyst for AI at Counterpoint Research, discusses the outlook for Chinese internet giants and leading AI labs. She spoke with Annabelle Droulers on Bloomberg: Tech Asia.

Reported by Bloomberg; The Japan Times.
